integrity: The limiting visibility and large-deviation exponent are derived analytically from the source formulas. Finite numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: No claim is made for \(c=1\) or \(c>1\).
The classical lower bound is restricted to the classical family and per-round energy constraint defined in the source.
The squeezed upper bound certifies one explicit protocol and is not a global quantum lower bound.
title: Linear-energy asymptotics for discretely phase-randomized squeezed sensing
